# ScriptOne - a generated Lua surface, as an example

**419 actions + 199 state values = 618 bindings across 131 tables.**
*Generated by tools/Gen-Bindings.ps1 - do not maintain by hand. These numbers are the source;
other files should point here instead of repeating them.*

> **This is one game's surface, not the ScriptOne API.** The names below come from the game
> this file happened to be generated against, and they are here so you can see what a
> surface looks like and how it is written down. **Your game will list different names.**
> ScriptOne finds them in the game you actually have, when it starts, and writes the
> result to `ScriptOne\surface.txt` plus a readable reference in `ScriptOne\documentation\`.
> The 13 `s1.*` core functions are the part that is the same everywhere - they are listed
> in `docs/CORE-VS-GAME.md`.

Generated from `surface/candidates.json`. **Do not edit by hand.**

Enums cross as numbers. A missing argument is 0 / "" / false, never an error.
